why: It would reject the observed Helios-42 false route scored at 0.00710329.
It retained all 58 of 58 useful fragments in the frozen 30-question sweep.
It rejected 22 of 44 irrelevant fragments, versus 6 of 44 under the current approximately 0.003 cutoff.
Raising the cutoff to 0.10 rejected four more irrelevant fragments but lost the first useful fragment, a conditional safety rule scored at 0.08897671.
interpretation: Use 0.05 as the conservative candidate lower cutoff. Later stages still have to reject the 22 irrelevant fragments that remain above it.
next_validation: Run the frozen 0.05 cutoff once on unseen questions over whole conversations, including answerable and no-answer cases. Do not tune it on that validation set.
claim_boundary: The selected value is fitted to public synthetic short fragments. It is not yet a locked production threshold for private whole-conversation retrieval.
